turns.speaker: ALEX
turns.text: Third story — and this one sits in a different category from the previous two. Anthropic announced yesterday what they're calling the Cyber Mission. Long-term initiative. The stated goal is securing the systems society actually runs on: power grids, water systems, transportation networks, government systems.

turns.speaker: JAMIE
turns.text: My first instinct was: this is a good story. Not because it's flawless, but because we spend a lot of time on this show asking what AI might break. This is a company saying — here's where we want to help hold something together.

turns.speaker: RUFUS
turns.text: It is also a company announcement, so the independent verification caveat applies from the start.
